host_adapter.tool: eligible current-turn synchronous or asynchronous question surface
host_adapter.tool_identity: logical adapter label, not an invocable function
host_adapter.synchronous_example: request_user_input only when exposed and eligible
host_adapter.feature_detection: effective current-turn tool surface plus mode, purpose, schema, and response lifecycle
host_adapter.app_server_request_scope: observed request_user_input transport example, not a universal asynchronous API

question_policy.recommendation: first option with impact and tradeoff
question_policy.free_form: offer only when it can materially improve the decision
question_policy.optional_only_surface: optional non-blocking clarification only; never required decisions or approvals
question_policy.required_choice: pause dependent commitments and implementation until a valid answer

routes.route: eligible current-turn synchronous or asynchronous question surface
one focused non-enumerated Default-mode question or explicit blocker

routes.need: open explanation, context, or faithful free-form answer
command, file-change, destructive, or external-action authorization

routes.route: host-approved secure input with observed protected schema, or stop

response_policy.option_answer: accept exactly one presented non-empty option
response_policy.other_answer: accept exactly one non-empty free-form answer only when Other is enabled
response_policy.asynchronous_dispatch_or_pending: leave unresolved; continue only independent authorized reversible work
response_policy.asynchronous_answer: validate eventual answer and correlation to current question and meaning
response_policy.tool_exposed_but_ineligible: use normal conversation for a required choice or report the blocker; never switch mode
response_policy.tool_unavailable_or_invocation_failed: allow at most one focused non-enumerated Default-mode fallback when the host permits, otherwise block

recheck_triggers: effective input-tool mode, purpose, schema, or response lifecycle changes
